ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.10.2 keeps the validated V0.4.10.1 JobGiver candidate partition and configurable worker-assist threshold, then adds a bounded refinement for common medium candidate sets. Supported 96-320 candidate arrays with meaningful spatial spread receive an additional stable 8-cell nearest-first ring pass after the existing 16-cell partition. Candidate membership is unchanged: the goal is only to let Vanilla establish a close best-distance earlier so later far candidates can avoid unnecessary expensive reachability/validator checks. No Reachability, WorkGiver validator, reservation or Job decision is moved off-thread. Vanilla remains authoritative. V0.4.8 slow JobPackage tracing, V0.4.7/V0.4.6 hauling fast paths, bounded path shadow validation and Butter++ logical-tick barriers are retained.
